description.value: Zenya Japanese Kitchen is a fast-casual Japanese restaurant tucked into the second-floor food court of International Village in downtown Vancouver, specializing in handmade onigiri with 19 fillings alongside udon, curry rice, donburi, and sandwiches. Opened in July 2023, it emphasizes traditional Japanese seasonings combined with locally sourced Vancouver ingredients. Delivery is available through Fantan and Uber Eats for cyclists who prefer off-bike pickup.
